svg.aria-label: Shared L2, the machinery around the array
svg.text: Shared L2, the machinery around the array
Patent readings, all speculative unless marked: how requests move through the L2, how it powers down, where lines enter the LRU stack, and how it shields the L1s.
Where a line enters the LRU stack
demand miss takes over a pending prefetch to its line
R A.0 waits for W A.0; R A.1 may pass W A.0
3 MiB per core; steps at 3 and 7.5 MiB
uses this L2 while P cores sleep
L2 DVFS follows the E cores
z: an all-zero line, a tag bit and no data write
invalid and zero lines live here
zero: data read returns zeros; a real write wakes the loser bank
bits carried by the victim from the L1
streams hold few ways; a sweep evicts 1/8 to 1/4
dirty L1 lines out before power down
